company_profile: TÜV SÜD is a testing, inspection and certification group whose digital unit builds data science and LLM solutions for areas such as medical technology, elevators, automotive and product testing.
title: Data Scientist
summary: Data Scientist with 8+ years applying data science and LLM methods across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Builds LLM solutions end to end, from document parsing with OCR and embeddings to RAG retrieval pipelines, multi-turn chat and systematic evaluation with LLM evaluators. Works in Python with solid engineering practice on Azure and GCP, and runs projects independently with business stakeholders. Currently building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

experience_edits.original: Deployed a production lab-extraction agent with Claude Opus 4.7
experience_edits.new: Deployed a production lab-extraction agent parsing documents with Amazon Textract and Claude Opus 4.7, integrated with LIMS, handling about 1,800 lab documents and automating the work behind 800 Jira tickets and PRD tasks.

experience_edits.original: Built automated evaluation and observability pipelines for Question Answering
experience_edits.new: Built automated evaluation and monitoring pipelines for Question Answering and Summary Agents with LLM evaluators, tracing and failure detection, reducing human-in-the-loop review by 43%.

experience_edits.original: Developed an internal RAG-based Project Discovery Assistant in LangGraph
experience_edits.new: Developed an internal RAG-based Project Discovery Assistant in LangGraph with a semantic retrieval pipeline and LLM reasoning, reaching a 90% match rate against existing organizational solutions.

experience_edits.original: Fine-tuned a cross-encoder on positive and negative pairs
experience_edits.new: Fine-tuned a cross-encoder on positive and negative pairs to re-rank dense embedding retrieval over AARP survey data, improving retrieval accuracy.

project.name: Test Report Parsing Assistant
bullets: Built an LLM pipeline that parses scanned test and inspection reports with OCR, extracts structured findings into a schema, and answers follow-up questions through RAG over embeddings.
Benchmarked extraction accuracy on a labelled document set, added guardrails and monitoring for quality, latency and cost, and deployed the service on Azure with FastAPI.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Data Scientist role in your digital unit in Munich. My recent work is building LLM solutions from start to finish, especially document parsing and retrieval pipelines in healthcare, on top of years of classical data science in telecom. What ties it together is turning unstructured data into something teams can rely on.

Testing and certification depend on reading large volumes of technical documents correctly, and I would like to help make that work faster and safer. There is a personal reason as well: my fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Munich together and settle there long term. I am learning German alongside.

I would bring practical experience with unstructured data and evaluation. I deployed an extraction agent using Amazon Textract and Claude on about 1,800 lab documents, and built evaluation pipelines with LLM evaluators that reduced human review by 43%. I am used to leading such projects directly with business teams.

Beyond work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It keeps me focused on building carefully for the people who use the system. I would be happy to discuss how I could support your team.
